#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
IFS=$'\n\t'

declare -A seen=()
files=( "$@" )
for f in "${files[@]:-}"; do
  [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
  case "$f" in
    *.go) echo "go: $f" ;;
    *) (( ${#seen[@]} > 0 )) && echo "seen" ;;
  esac
  seen["$f"]=1
done
while read -r line; do printf '%s\n' "${line^^}"; done < <(printf 'a\nb\n')
out=$(mktemp) && trap 'rm -f "$out"' EXIT
cat <<-EOF > "$out"
	heredoc ${HOME:-/}
EOF
if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi
